config.modest_meals.title: Modest Meals Configuration
config.modest_meals.category.gameplay.to: Configure hunger mechanics, health regeneration, stamina, and status effects.
config.modest_meals.group.hunger.tooltip: Settings related to hunger elimination, hunger effect replacement, and eating speed.
config.modest_meals.group.health_regener: Settings related to gradual food digestion and healing over time.
config.modest_meals.group.mechanics.tool: Configure stamina sprint duration, recharge delays, and movement recovery.
config.modest_meals.category.hud.tooltip: Configure stamina bar, heart overlays, and item tooltips.
config.modest_meals.group.stamina_bar.to: Configure stamina bar visibility and flashing animations.
config.modest_meals.group.hud_restored_h: Visual highlight of hearts restored by held food items on the health bar.
config.modest_meals.group.hud_regenerate: Visual pulsing animation of hearts currently being digested and regenerated.
config.modest_meals.group.hud_tooltips.t: Settings for food health icons and digestion speed tooltips.
config.modest_meals.category.farmers_del: Compatibility settings for Farmer's Delight mod.
config.modest_meals.option.disable_hunge: When enabled, removes the hunger system. Food directly restores health or starts gradual regeneration.
config.modest_meals.option.hunger_effect:
What the Hunger effect does once the hunger system is disabled.
Vanilla: Hunger becomes Stamina Depletion, halving stamina recovery for the same duration.
Disabled: Hunger effect cannot be applied to players.
Replaced with other effect: Instead of Hunger, players receive a replacement effect (e.g. Poison) with modified duration.
config.modest_meals.option.hunger_replac: Resource ID of the effect that replaces the Hunger effect (e.g. minecraft:poison).
Duration multiplier for the replacement effect (0.5 means half duration).
config.modest_meals.option.instant_eatin: When enabled, removes the eating animation, making food consumption instantaneous.
config.modest_meals.option.gradual_healt: When enabled, health regenerates gradually over time after eating food instead of instantly.
Overall speed multiplier at which health is restored from digested food.
config.modest_meals.option.regeneration_:
Stopped: Remaining regeneration is discarded when reaching full health.
Continued: Digestion continues in the background if damage is taken during the digestion period.
Stored: Digestion pauses at full health and resumes upon taking damage.
config.modest_meals.option.sprinting.too:
Controls sprinting rules when Stamina Sprint is disabled:
Vanilla: Standard behavior.
Disabled: Sprinting is disabled.
Limited by Health: Sprinting is only permitted above the health threshold.
config.modest_meals.option.sprinting_hea: Minimum health points required to sprint when Limited by Health is selected (6 = 3 hearts).
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_sprin: When enabled, players have a dedicated stamina pool for sprinting. Depleting it completely triggers exhaustion until refilled.
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_infin: When enabled, stamina never depletes on Peaceful difficulty.
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_regai: Controls how quickly stamina recovers while walking or moving: Normal, Half rate, or None (idle only).
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_durat: The continuous sprint time in seconds before stamina is completely depleted.
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_recha: The time in seconds required to recharge from 0% back to 100% capacity when exhausted.
config.modest_meals.option.stamina_coold: The delay in seconds after stopping sprinting before stamina begins to naturally recover.
config.modest_meals.option.hide_hunger_b: Removes the hunger bar from the HUD and restores the classic HUD layout with air bubbles above hearts on the left and armor on the right.
config.modest_meals.option.hide_stamina_: Hides the stamina bar icon display from the HUD.
Disables the red indicator icons shown when stamina cannot recover while moving.
Disables the blue indicator icons shown while stamina is on recharge delay cooldown.
Only displays the stamina bar when stamina is depleted, depleting, or exhausted.
config.modest_meals.option.highlight_sta: Renders a white outline over the stamina icons while sprinting.
config.modest_meals.option.flash_stamina: Flashes the stamina bar icons briefly when stamina reaches 100% full capacity.
Pulses the stamina bar when stamina drops below this amount (0-20, 0 to disable).
config.modest_meals.option.highlight_res: Highlights the amount of stamina that will be restored when holding a food item.
config.modest_meals.option.restored_stam: Color tint applied to restorable stamina on the stamina bar.
config.modest_meals.option.highlight_res: Highlights the number of hearts that will be healed when holding a food item.
config.modest_meals.option.restored_hear: Texture style used to render potentially restorable hearts.
Color tint applied to restorable hearts on the health bar.
config.modest_meals.option.highlight_reg: Renders a pulsing animation for hearts currently being regenerated by digested food.
config.modest_meals.option.regenerated_h: Texture style used to render currently regenerating hearts.
Color tint applied to regenerating hearts on the health bar.
Minimum opacity level during heart pulsing animation.
Maximum opacity level during heart pulsing animation.
Pulsing animation period length in milliseconds.
config.modest_meals.option.show_food_ite: Displays heart icons in food item tooltips showing the amount of health restored.
config.modest_meals.option.show_food_reg: Displays the digestion speed (e.g. Fast Regeneration) on food item tooltips.
config.modest_meals.option.show_stamina_: Displays an on-screen numerical text overlay showing remaining stamina percentage.
config.modest_meals.option.use_dynamic_s: Dynamically color-codes stamina text according to current percentage and state.
config.modest_meals.option.alt_stamina_s: Only renders the stamina text when stamina is depleted or exhausted.
config.modest_meals.option.alt_stamina_c: The screen corner where stamina text is positioned.
config.modest_meals.option.alt_stamina_o: X-axis pixel offset for stamina text.
Y-axis pixel offset for stamina text.
config.modest_meals.option.alt_stamina_s: Enables drop shadow behind stamina text.
config.modest_meals.option.alt_stamina_t: Format template for stamina text. Use %v for stamina value, and % followed by a color code (e.g. %a, %c).
